response.reason: FP16 products are exact in FP32, the FP32 sum is accurately rounded relative to its own true value (no spurious cancellation error since operands are exact), and div_rn is correctly rounded, so each component's relative error (~2^-23) is well within the 1e-7 + 5e-7*|target| tolerance; masked loads/stores and the nonzero-denominator domain keep outputs finite. The other=1 default for masked c only affects inactive lanes.
